name: libowfat
why: Fefe's reimplementation of djb's libraries, a clean door into the old qmail and djbdns world.

brief.what_it_is: libowfat is described in its Homebrew formula as a reimplementation of libdjb, D. J. Bernstein's C library collection. I could not read the project's own description, so this comes only from the formula text and a scout note. The scout note says it is a clean route into the old qmail and djbdns ecosystem. I cannot say from these notes what inputs it takes or what outputs it produces.
brief.why_it_exists: The formula gives no stated motivation. The scout note suggests it exists to offer a cleaner, reimplemented path into the qmail and djbdns world, but that is the scout's reading, not the author's.
brief.standout: The scout note calls it a clean door into the qmail and djbdns world. I could not verify that claim against the project's own docs.
brief.caveats: The homepage was unreachable. Both http://www.fefe.de/libowfat/ and https://www.fefe.de/libowfat/ failed to load (RemoteDisconnected and URLError), so there is no README, release date, commit history, or command examples to check. Everything in this brief beyond the formula description is unverified.
